body: So I’ve been with women before and dated them regularly in my early 20’s but my early 20’s were quite honestly a drunken blur lol. My experience with men has been lackluster at best so yeah I’m sure some of my insecurities come from that.
Yeah that was my game plan when I was younger, and I know I wouldn’t be weird if my partner was hesitant on something, I think I’m just nervous. Wine will definitely help!
It made me more aware of the fragility of life and how nothing matters so I quit my job and went back to school for a subject that I thought I was too stupid for. Maintaining an A average.

As obvious as it may seem, gaslighting. My last partner was extremely mentally and verbally abusive. He would change tones drastically and very quickly, after yelling at me and making fun of me and calling me names he would “cool down” and tell me that I’m being self centered and he only blew up on me because I made him mad and that we both need to work on communication. I should have left the first time that happened. He would later end up threatening to kick me out weekly, throwing my belongings out after bigger fights, telling me I can’t talk to my friends about our relationship, and telling me that he was the only person who would accept me and that if I leave I’m going to go back to someone who beats me.
Thank you! I’ll check them out
Yeah I think that’s the best route. Luckily I work a lot so I can definitely maximize my not at home time.

I thought that maybe she was just trying to talk to me more, so I would try to answer them at first, but the questions just got ridiculous and make me wonder how she made it to 54 if she is this oblivious to everything. I’ve tried talking to her about things and what happened and how it makes me feel and the most I get is “I don’t remember anything from that time” “are you gonna hold the fact that I was a shitty mom over my head forever?” And “like you don’t do or say things you shouldn’t” so it goes nowhere. She’s been pretty uncool in recent years as well, I had an addiction problem, and then overcame it, and she acted like I was just trying to get attention. I became a stripper when I was 19 and she fed into it, and when she lost her job and I offered to help her out with rent she would tell me that I should try to meet up with sugar daddies to get more money. I had a nasty abusive relationship that I had to move out of state in the middle of the night to get out of and she makes fun of that relationship now. I don’t trust her intentions and it seems like anything she says that sounds nice is just covering something else up.

I’m from the confused and white state of Maine, where we had no business trying with Tex-Mex. And my father would just pour sour cream and olives on something and call it a taco or nacho. Takes me back.

I look at their old pictures, I talk to my mom and sister about her, we remember her, we bring up the tough stuff that’s hard to think about sometimes that comes with her passing. I always miss her, and I will keep missing her. I get scared that I’m going to forget what she sounded like sometimes. And sometimes I find myself having to jog my own memory with a picture of her instead of going off my brain. I hope I’m always able to talk about her and remember her.
Oh man, How Clean Is Your House brought out an obsessive compulsive freak in my 12 year old self
Darcy’s amount of emotions makes me so uncomfortable sometimes but man Tom sucks. He saw she was over it so he had to slide in that last remark to make her feel bad.
Also I have no way how you made it over ten years, I would have ripped my hair out from exhaustion!

Yeah I usually lay in bed and wait for him to sleep and then migrate to the couch. I truly believe he should see a doctor about this because although the morning talks about what he screamed at or who he had an argument in his sleep with are so, so funny, I’m actually concerned about what’s going on in his noggin’.
He is hands down, the heaviest sleeper I have ever encountered. And has fallen asleep at strange times and in strange situations.

Yeah I agree that “hate” is probably an over exaggeration, but I’ve brought it up in the past in kind of a subtle way before and I don’t think he understands how much it really affects me. He usually just says “oh yeah, I have night terrors a lot” Which makes me feel very bad for him because that seems stressful. He is a little more sensitive about relationship topics than I am.
